description: Shell additive state + Status_Bar common-segment model + single-chrome regression guard (workspace-framework Phase CF.1-CF.6). Add the transient Message_Line store and the last_action_at timestamp as ADDITIVE shell state, wire their clear/stamp into the per-action dispatch seam, render the Message_Line as a bottom panel directly ABOVE the Status_Bar, remove the redundant RUNNING segment, replace Started: with Last:, shorten Profile: to Prof:, add the per-Kind Workspace_Status_Segment composition point (empty default), and prove the eight-element common frame renders once with a full-shell regression guard. TDD-first.
steps: Read context.json FIRST (it replaces re-exploration). Work inside the worktree; use absolute worktree paths.

CF.1 (Req 7.11-7.14,7.16,7.27): Write FAILING unit tests in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/tests_session.rs: setting message_line makes messages readable; calling note_action_dispatched() clears them before the action; last_action_at is None initially and Some after an action. Then ADD fields message_line: Vec<String> and last_action_at: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Local>> on WorkbenchShell in shell/state.rs (near session_start), init them in shell/construct.rs (message_line: Vec::new(), last_action_at: None), and add note_action_dispatched(&mut self) in shell/actions.rs (clears message_line, stamps last_action_at = Some(chrono::Local::now())). Make the tests pass.

CF.1.3 (Req 7.8,7.13,7.14): Add render_message_line(ctx) in shell/render_status.rs as a TopBottomPanel::bottom("message_line") that early-returns when message_line is empty, else renders one non-interactive label row per message (not a Tab stop, mirroring the status-bar label pattern). Call it in shell/update.rs AFTER render_status_bar so it stacks directly above the status bar. Write a headless test (mirror the render_status_bar headless test in tests_focus.rs) asserting absent-when-empty and N-rows-when-N-messages.

CF.1.2 wiring (Req 7.12,7.14,7.16): Call self.note_action_dispatched() at the TOP of begin_command_line() (shell/commands_line.rs) AND at the top of dispatch_bound_command() (shell/target_dispatch.rs). Write a failing test that seeds message_line, runs a command via handle_command/run_command_line, and asserts message_line is empty afterward unless the action re-populated it. Double-invocation on the key path is harmless (idempotent clear, same-action restamp).

CF.2 (Req 7.15,7.20): Write a failing test asserting the composed Status_Bar contains no RUNNING phase segment. Then in render_status_bar REMOVE the phase_label match and its ui.label(phase_label). Update any existing test that asserted RUNNING in the live status bar.

CF.3 (Req 7.16,7.18): Write a failing unit test for format_last_action() yielding 'Last: HH:MM' (and a blank/placeholder when last_action_at is None), mirroring format_session_start_produces_started_hhmm. Add format_last_action(&self) in shell/actions.rs and replace the ui.label(self.format_session_start()) status segment with ui.label(self.format_last_action()). Keep the session_start field + format_session_start (still used by the logoff message) -- only the STATUS-BAR segment changes.

CF.4 (Req 7.19): Write a failing test asserting active_profile_label() yields 'Prof: <name>' / 'Prof: default'. Shorten active_profile_label in shell/actions.rs from 'Profile:' to 'Prof:'. Update tests_misc.rs::active_profile_label_reflects_active_profile expectation.

CF.5 (Req 7.17,7.21,7.27): Write a failing test proving the status composition includes a Kind-contributed segment slot alongside the common segments (empty is acceptable). Add workspace_status_segment(&self) -> String returning String::new() for now, and render it after the common segments in render_status_bar. If this appears to REQUIRE a new Kind-registry trait method, STOP and surface to the owner per design.md -- do NOT add it unilaterally.

CF.6 (Req 7.1,7.5,7.6,7.22-7.24,7.27): Write a full-shell egui_kittest test (harness_shell()) asserting the command field (command_field_input) is present, the Status_Bar and the new Message_Line are DISTINCT bottom panels, the key bar follows key_bar_visible/pfshow, and no active Workspace re-draws a frame element in content (reuse the full_shell_alias_editor_is_single_chrome pattern: redundant surface title count stays 0). Put it in a new tests_common_frame.rs if tests_focus.rs would exceed ~200 added lines. Confirm the existing full_shell_first_tab_* tests remain green WITHOUT modifying them.

COMPILE-VERIFY only: run SCOPED cargo check -p ff-desktop, cargo clippy -p ff-desktop -- -D warnings, cargo fmt -p ff-desktop -- --check, and the SCOPED new tests (cargo test -p ff-desktop message_line / last_action / prof_ / status / common_frame). Read the result/log output. Do NOT run the full suite. Commit locally on the branch; do not push.

Set this FEAT status to completed and record in findings the EXACT implemented names (note_action_dispatched, format_last_action, render_message_line, workspace_status_segment, message_line, last_action_at) for FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 to cite.
acceptance_criteria: message_line (Vec<String>) and last_action_at (Option<DateTime<Local>>) exist as additive shell fields; no public framework type reshaped.
note_action_dispatched() clears message_line and stamps last_action_at, and is invoked at begin_command_line and dispatch_bound_command so every user action triggers it.
render_message_line renders a bottom panel directly above the Status_Bar, absent when empty, expanding for multiple messages.
The live Status_Bar shows no RUNNING segment, shows 'Last: HH:MM' (not 'Started:'), shows 'Prof: <name>' (not 'Profile:'), and includes an (empty) per-Kind Workspace_Status_Segment slot.

A full-shell egui_kittest test proves the eight frame elements render once with Status_Bar and Message_Line as distinct panels and no in-content frame-element duplication; existing full-shell first-Tab tests stay green.
Every new test carries a // Validates: Requirement 7.x annotation.
findings:
DONE. All scoped checks clean on branch common-frame-impl: cargo check -p ff-desktop --tests (rc 0), cargo clippy -p ff-desktop --tests -- -D warnings (rc 0), cargo fmt -p ff-desktop -- --check (rc 0). Scoped tests all pass: message_line (4), common_frame (3), last_action (2), active_profile_label (1). EXACT IMPLEMENTED CODE NAMES (FEAT-002/003 cite these):

SHELL STATE (crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/state.rs, on struct WorkbenchShell, both pub(crate), placed immediately after `session_start`):
  - `message_line: Vec<String>` -- transient Message_Line store (CR-NR-115 Phase CF).
  - `last_action_at: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Local>>` -- timestamp of last dispatched action; None until first action.
Init in crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/construct.rs (end of the struct literal in new_with_history_store): `message_line: Vec::new(), last_action_at: None`.

PER-ACTION HOOK (crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/actions.rs, impl WorkbenchShell, pub(crate)):
  - `fn note_action_dispatched(&mut self)` -- clears message_line AND stamps last_action_at = Some(chrono::Local::now()). This is THE per-action seam.
  - `fn format_last_action(&self) -> String` -- returns `Last: HH:MM` from last_action_at, or the placeholder `Last: --:--` when None (NOT a ticking clock).
  - `fn active_profile_label(&self) -> String` -- SHORTENED from `Profile:` to `Prof:` (returns `Prof: <name>` / `Prof: default`). (format_session_start + session_start field RETAINED, still used by the logoff message; only the status-bar segment changed.)

WIRING (note_action_dispatched is invoked at the TWO shared dispatch seams):
  - crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/commands_line.rs :: begin_command_line() -- called at the TOP (covers typed Enter + key-forward command-line paths).
  - crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/target_dispatch.rs :: dispatch_bound_command() -- called at the TOP (menu-option clicks + shortcuts). Double-invocation on the key path is harmless (idempotent clear, same-action restamp).

RENDER (crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/render_status.rs, impl WorkbenchShell, both pub(super)):
  - `fn render_message_line(&mut self, ctx: &egui::Context)` -- egui::TopBottomPanel::bottom("message_line"); early-returns when message_line is empty (panel absent); else one non-interactive ui.label row per message (not a Tab stop). Panel id string = "message_line".
  - `fn workspace_status_segment(&self) -> String` -- the per-Kind Workspace_Status_Segment composition point; returns String::new() for now (empty default). FEAT that adds per-Kind content fills this in (or introduces a per-Kind gate). Rendered in render_status_bar AFTER the common segments, guarded by `if !kind_segment.is_empty()`.
  - render_status_bar: REMOVED the RUNNING LifecyclePhase match + its ui.label (and the now-unused `use ff_core::LifecyclePhase;` import). Status bar order is now: Last: HH:MM (format_last_action) -> Prof: (active_profile_label) -> Ln,Col -> encoding -> [zoom] -> line count -> [workspace_status_segment] -> [modified] -> [CAPS] -> [open_error] -> right-aligned banner/log-degraded.

PANEL ORDER (crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/update.rs, update()): `self.render_message_line(ctx)` is called IMMEDIATELY AFTER `self.render_status_bar(ctx)` (egui bottom panels stack upward in call order, so the message line sits directly ABOVE the status bar). Existing order render_key_label_bar -> render_status_bar preserved; render_message_line is the new third call.

TESTS ADDED (// Validates: Requirement 7.x annotations):
  - tests_session.rs: message_line_is_readable_and_cleared_by_note_action_dispatched (7.11/7.12), last_action_at_is_none_initially_and_some_after_action (7.16), message_line_cleared_when_command_dispatched (7.12/7.14/7.16), format_last_action_produces_last_hhmm (7.16/7.18).
  - tests_misc.rs: active_profile_label_reflects_active_profile UPDATED to expect `Prof:` (7.19).
